# How big an annual-prepay discount can you afford to offer?

> Free SaaS annual plan discount calculator: find the annual-prepay discount you can offer before it costs more than it brings in, given gross margin, monthly churn, renewal rate and cost of capital. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
